subject: general
question: Which of the following peaks of the Himalayas is located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kamet Peak is the highest point in the Zanskar range located at an altitude of 7756 meters.
 
• Zaskar Range also called Zanskar, group of mountains in the Himalayas, of northern India and the western Tibet Autonomous Region of China.
 
• They extend southeastward for some 640 km from the Karcha River to the upper Karnali River.
 
• The most important passes are Shipki, Lipu Lekh, and Mana.
 
• Zaskar is drained by the Zaskar River which flows northward, joining the Indus River below Leh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Dhaulagiri **

 
 
• Mount Dhaulagiri is located in the west-central Nepal.
 
• Mount Dhaulagiri, at 8,167 metres (26,795 feet) above sea level, is the seventh-highest mountain in the world and the tallest mountain that is entirely contained inside one nation's borders (Nepal).
 
• Around 40 miles (65 km) northwest of Annapurna, it is located on the western side of the vast Kali (Kali Gandak) River valley.
 
• The majority of the Himalayas, the highest mountain range in the world, are found in Nepal. The nation is home to eight of the fourteen eight-thousanders, either entirely or in part by way of a shared border with China or India.
 
• Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world, and 1,310 other peaks that rise beyond 6,000 metres are both found in Nepal.
